name: seam
label: Hypr Seam
description: Per-corner window rounding with a book-seam adjacency flag. Flattens corners when windows touch neighbors.

options.label: Enable Seam
options.description: Global master switch to enable/disable seam behavior.

options.label: Force Round Risky Surfaces
options.description: Also round subsurfaces that reach a window corner (needed for Firefox/Zen where page content is a full-window subsurface).

options.label: Round Borders
options.description: Round the native border to match each window's live corner radii.

options.label: Round Shadows
options.description: Round the native drop shadow to match each window's live corner radii.

options.label: Base Corner Radius
options.description: Base corner radius in pixels used when per-corner values are unset (-1).

options.label: Top Left Radius
options.description: Top-left corner radius. Set to -1 to fall back to base radius.

options.label: Top Right Radius
options.description: Top-right corner radius. Set to -1 to fall back to base radius.

options.label: Bottom Left Radius
options.description: Bottom-left corner radius. Set to -1 to fall back to base radius.

options.label: Bottom Right Radius
options.description: Bottom-right corner radius. Set to -1 to fall back to base radius.

options.label: Rounding Power (Squircle)
options.description: Squircle exponent passed to Hyprland's rounded-rect shader. Higher values make corners more rounded/squircle-like.

options.label: Seam Radius
options.description: Radius in pixels applied to corners that are touching a neighbor (flattened).

options.label: Touch Tolerance
options.description: Maximum pixel gap to consider two window edges as touching. Set to -1 to derive automatically from gaps_in (max(gaps_in)*3 + 6, min 8.0).

options.label: Animate Transitions
options.description: Ease corner radius changes between states.

options.label: Animation Speed (ms)
options.description: Transition duration in milliseconds for corner radius animations.

options.label: Animation Curve
options.description: Bezier curve name used for corner radius animations (e.g., default, easeOutCubic, linear).
